items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: It was nice to see Al and here's what really happened.

ctx.x: That's right. He came by one night to see us at the club, Streets of Paris, where we were working, Art Tatum Trio. It was nice to see Al and here's what really happened. Al Hibbler and Art, they used to get in arguments, you know, friendly arguments, of who could do this and who could do that, you know. I imagine they were referring to their being blind and what have you and Art would say he can do things better than Al could do them and vice versa, you know. And this particular night, when Hibbler came in, as we…

we had asked Al to come with us up to Lovejoy's on this particular night to jam a little while, you know, to a session. So one word led on to another between Al and Art and somehow, they started arguing amongst themself -- I don't know how it started -- they started arguing, friendly-like, about who could drive a car, you know?
